extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 1950s pickup truck, approx. 5.3 x 2.3 x 1.9 m (L x W x H incl. mirrors), wheel diameter 0.74 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; generic 1950s pickup with rounded cab, wraparound windshield, two-tone paint (sage body, cream roof), wide chrome grille, round headlights with chrome visors, step-side bed with round rear fenders, running boards and wooden floor and whitewall tyres; the tailgate '1950s-pickup-truck_tailgate' is a separate object with its origin on the bottom hinge (rotate around local X by -90 degrees to fold it down); 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cab with transparent windows, bench seat and steering wheel; no brand, no logo, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
